optimizedContext.value:
# GetProjectContext

## Rules
- `execute(GetProjectContextInput)`: optional contextMode list|summary|full|hybrid, llmOptimizedContext, followDeps, depth, sections; no config. Shallow-merge runtime mode/optimization over construction defaults. Returns ordered contextEntries, deduplicated specs, warnings; every spec source includePattern; hybrid=full.
- Resolve schema first via `SchemaProvider.get()`; propagate schema errors. Constructor injects ListWorkspaces, SchemaProvider, FileReader, GetSpecMetadata, ArtifactParserRegistry, default CompileContextConfig; schema lazy.
- Render project context declaration order before specs. Instruction label `**Source: instruction**`; file through FileReader, label path, shift headings +1; missing file warns/skips.
- Collect project contextIncludeSpecs across configured workspaces then exclude via shared `resolveConfiguredContextSpecs` with empty activeWorkspaces; never apply workspace-level patterns or fork matcher. Deduplicate first occurrence.
- Optional followDeps traverses canonical dependencies transitively, depth-limited: self-healing `GetSpecMetadata` projection first; schema dependsOn extraction fallback with shared transforms/origin context only when no projection. Never read spec-lock directly. Transform normalization failures explicit.
- Classify before materialization. list emits IDs and never calls metadata. summary emits title/description. full/hybrid emit structured extraction, never raw Markdown; default no-filter output is Description + Rules + Constraints, explicit sections override.
- Regenerated metadata is valid provenance, not warning. Forward actionable materialization warnings without re-logging. No valid projection → missing-metadata, live schema extraction, then empty heading if declarations absent. Found but unnormalizable transformed data fails.
- Optimization enabled: use fresh nonempty project optimized context from core:project-metadata. Freshness uses semantic fingerprints of specd.yaml, contextFiles, included-spec materialized metadata. Disabled/stale/empty → standard compilation; stale/empty warning says `Launch specd-project-context-optimizer agent to generate it`.
- Rendered spec without usable optimizedContext warns missing-optimization or stale-optimization with `Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh`; no change-scope exemptions.
- Factory `createGetProjectContext(config, options?)` delegates through `resolveGetProjectContextDeps(resolver)` then canonical deps factory; helper resolves listWorkspaces/schemaProvider/files/getMetadata/parsers/hasher/extractorTransforms/workspaceRoutes/defaultConfig.

## Constraints
- No change context; all configured workspaces available, but workspace patterns never applied.
- Context entries precede spec content; duplicate matches collapse.
- Formatting matches CompileContext. Traversal only with followDeps=true.
- Factory does not rebuild fs wiring inline.
